issues.description: The UML in the problem statement defines RollerCoaster.numberOfLoopings as a private attribute ( '-' ), but the solution implementation declares numberOfLoopings as protected. This contradicts the UML-specified visibility and may confuse students about the intended access level for the attribute.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility of numberOfLoopings match the UML (private). Declare numberOfLoopings as private in RollerCoaster and ensure subclasses and other classes access it via the public getter getNumberOfLoopings(). Update any code that relies on direct field access accordingly. This preserves the intended encapsulation shown in the UML and removes confusion about attribute visibility.
